name: Anyware Robotics Pixmo
summary: A mobile box-handling robot that pairs an autonomous mobile base with a FANUC CRX collaborative arm and a conveyor add-on to unload floor-loaded containers and trailers; it also palletizes and tends machines.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU sales route found; Anyware Robotics deploys Pixmo at US logistics sites and takes enquiries through its own contact form.

specs.label: Arm
specs.value: FANUC CRX collaborative robot on an AMR base
specs.conditions: with a patent-pending conveyor add-on for transfer to outbound conveyors or pallets
specs.quote: A FANUC CRX collaborative robot and autonomous mobile robot (AMR) base for precision and safety

specs.label: Container unload time
specs.conditions: per container at Saddle Creek Logistics, Modesto

specs.label: Staffing effect
specs.quote: reduced staffing from 4-5 operators to 1-2 operators.

specs.label: Site infrastructure
specs.value: No permanent conveyors or infrastructure changes needed
specs.quote: Pixmo is mobile, requiring no permanent conveyors or infrastructure changes

notes: Arm payload is the maker's 50 lb case weight converted to kg.

Works on dock floors and container/trailer floors; ramps mentioned by the maker.
